summary: The audit checks the 42-unit core (six theory and ear-training courses for 12 units, MUSIC 40-42, three upper-division history and analysis courses, and performance and composition units), a WIM course from MUSIC 141-148 for at least 4 units, a capstone (MUSIC 198A and 198B for Composition), and your concentration of at least 20 units, the capstone's units included (the 42-unit core plus 20), 62 units in all. Every course counted toward the major must be letter graded unless it is offered only satisfactory/no credit; extra electives beyond the requirements may be credit/no credit. A core course cannot also count toward your concentration. Checked by hand: the piano proficiency and ear-training exit exams and the 2.0 GPA. Honors is optional.

node.name: Independent project of exceptional quality, adjudicated by the faculty

add.why: "The faculty awards honors in music to majors who have produced an independent project of exceptional quality through a concentration." "Honors are conferred through faculty adjudication."
GPA: "A minimum GPA of 2.0 in all coursework."

Capstone, Composition Majors: "In senior year, during the quarter immediately preceding the capstone concert, Composition concentration students should enroll in at least 1 unit of MUSIC 198A ... During the the same quarter as the capstone concert, Composition concentration students should enroll in 1 unit of MUSIC 198B." The Capstone block lets any major pick either option, so the Composition subplan asks for this one; it also counts as the capstone.

"Of the required 62 units, 42 comprise the shared foundation. You can devote the remaining 20 minimum required units to an area of focus ... Mentorship under the guidance of a faculty advisor is an indispensable component of this 20-unit requirement." The core rules add up to the 42 units without the capstone, so the capstone ("project is determined by subplan field") is part of the 20; the Self-Designed subplan says so outright: "They are allocated 16 units toward courses in this focus area; the remaining four units are reserved for the capstone project." This rule carries the capstone's units into the concentration's 20-unit floor; it asks for nothing on its own.
